study_guide.title: Study Guide- Circulation and Breathing module- 2026-2027.pdf

test_bank_reference.purpose: Style reference only. Never use test-bank content as the factual source for AI-generated questions or flashcards.

rules: A Drive file must be matched to an official Study Guide topic before generation.
The matched Study Guide teaching method must be one of the three allowed methods.
If the match or teaching method is uncertain, do not publish the deck/question set.
Department folder location alone never makes a file eligible.
eligibility.gender_folder_rule: Scan both Male and Female official lecture folders as parallel sources. A lecture may be published from either folder; never require a Male copy to exist.

ai_questions.source_of_truth: Eligible lecture slides + that lecture's official Study Guide learning objectives
ai_questions.style_reference: Existing MED25 past papers and coordinator formative on the website
requirements: Plausible same-domain distractors aimed at common confusions.
Concise KAU/MED25-style stems; avoid unnecessarily long USMLE-style vignettes.
Mix high-yield recall, mechanisms/relationships and short clinical/application questions when the lecture supports them.
Collectively cover the official objectives before adding lower-yield slide details.
Never invent content or use knowledge outside the lecture to make a question harder.
Never recycle unrelated flashcard answers as distractors.

checks: Source is matched to an eligible official Study Guide lecture and its objectives.
Exactly four non-empty, semantically distinct options.
Exactly one unambiguously best answer supported by the lecture.
All distractors are plausible same-domain near misses; do not recycle unrelated correct answers from other questions.
Question resembles MED25 past-paper/formative style: concise SBA, usually short direct stem or compact clinical/application scenario.
Collectively covers the official lecture objectives before lower-yield slide details.
No unsupported facts outside the lecture.
Explanation is question-specific and explains why the keyed answer fits; generic boilerplate is not acceptable.
quality_gate.legacy_hold_rule: Any existing AI set that fails these checks remains hidden (quality_status=hold, exam_ready=false) until rebuilt.

flashcards.source_of_truth: Eligible lecture slides + that lecture's official Study Guide learning objectives
requirements: Prioritize mechanisms, comparisons, discriminations and exam-relevant facts over trivia.
Keep cards concise enough for daily spaced-repetition review.

images.use_when: A lecture visual materially improves recall or interpretation, especially anatomy, histology, ECGs, graphs, pathways, tables and image-based recognition.
images.storage: Use persistent repository assets under flashcard-media/. Never publish expiring thumbnail URLs.
images.rule: Use lecture-derived visuals only when useful; do not add decorative images.

actions: Scan both official Male and Female lecture folders plus the organized MED25 root for new or modified files.
Pool Male and Female sources by lecture concept; if either contains an eligible lecture, it is available for generation.
Match each candidate to the Study Guide topic and teaching method.
For new/modified eligible lectures, generate or refresh AI questions and flashcards using the official objectives.
Audit existing eligible AI sets for MED25/test-bank-like quality and rebuild weak flashcard-like question sets.
Add useful lecture images to flashcards when appropriate.
Validate JSON, mappings, question quality and eligibility before publishing.
Deploy the updated website only when content changed.

drive_sources.rule: Male and Female official doctor-slide folders are parallel authoritative sources. A lecture may be sourced from either. Never require a Male copy before publishing.
drive_sources.duplicate_handling: When both gender folders contain the same official eligible lecture, compare versions and use the current/most complete official delivery while preserving stable content IDs where the concept is unchanged.

source_scope.rule: Scan both official Male and Female lecture folders across all sex-split subjects. Do not prefer one sex over the other. If an eligible lecture exists in either folder, use it; if both exist, publish one deduplicated lecture using the clearest/latest official version.
source_scope.shared_subject_rule: Also scan non-sex-split official folders such as Microbiology and Anatomy/Histology/Embryology under the module root.

academic_taxonomy.rule: IBLS, CVS and Formative are never subjects or lectures. They may be retained only as source/provenance metadata.

past_papers.organization: Map every authentic question to official Study Guide subject + lecture; source bank remains provenance only.
past_papers.mock_exam_rule: Only structurally exam-ready items enter mocks: >=4 distinct options, keyed answer present among options, official lecture mapping present. De-duplicate exact stems within a mock.
past_papers.incomplete_items: Authentic incomplete extractions may remain visible in Past Papers with a Source incomplete warning, but are excluded from mocks.
past_papers.explanation_rule: Do not show misleading generic boilerplate as if it were lecture-specific reasoning. Flag/rebuild weak explanations.
